title: Brain as food
lead:
{{Short description|none}}
[[File:Detalle de los Sesos de Cordero-Brains of Lamb.jpg|thumb|right|Lamb brains sold as food]]
[[File:Gulai Otak.jpg|thumb|{{lang|id|[[Gulai otak]]}}, cattle's brain curry from Indonesia]]
The [[brain]], like most other internal organs, or [[offal]], can serve as nourishment. Brains used for nourishment include those of [[pig]]s, [[squirrel]]s, [[rabbit]]s, [[horse]]s, [[cattle]], [[monkey]]s, [[chicken]]s, [[camel]]s, [[fish]], [[lamb and mutton|lamb]], and [[goat]]s. In many cultures, different types of brain are considered a [[delicacy]].
